instructions: Use docs/COGNITIVE_TASKS.md and the included result schema. Return JSON {results:[{case_id,result}]} only. Do not use tools, publish memory, or invent facts. Each result must meet its task and original source evidence. Model identity/cost are null unless known. Findings are concise, not private reasoning. General model knowledge has no memory citations. A derived finding names the IDs of premise findings. For missing original bytes return insufficient or qualified partial. Follow each forced_stop_reason. Questions have origin golem, kind cognitive_question or collection_request, explicit intent, reply_to user-1 and premise_ids. The usage and coverage fields are supplied per case and must be retained.
